2) The broad drop in flux from 380 to 520 nm is due to the cumulative absorption of many molecules introduced during the third dredge up. Which of the following statements best describes the effect of this spectral feature on the star's observed B-V?

Y) B-V remains unchanged because both B and V fluxes are equally affected
Z) B-V becomes negative because the V-band flux dominates the spectrum
